svg.text: Entity relationship diagram · PostgreSQL · the 8 domain tables (Laravel's own personal_access_tokens, sessions, cache and jobs tables are left out)

g.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · UK unique · 1 / N: one row on this side relates to many rows on the other · every foreign key is cascade-deleted except events.venue_id (restrict) and bookings.seat_id (set null)
